research_question: Which assessments and preferences about cultural practices are explicitly expressed in our permitted Chinese and English source passages?
inclusion_criteria: Exact contiguous passages expressing an assessment, preference or explicit stance about the chosen cultural practices.
Retain attribution and surrounding context; keep human-authored and generated source origins distinct.
exclusion_criteria: An inferred attitude with no explicit supporting passage.
Treating a quotation, hypothetical view or model response as a verified population preference.
